title: A literal without a decimal point is an integer

source.quote: VAR Quantity = 100000 -- Integer VAR Discount = 0.10 -- Decimal VAR UnitPrice = CURRENCY ( 12.3456 ) -- Currency
source.supports: a literal without a decimal point is an Integer, one with a decimal point a Decimal (double), CURRENCY ( ) gives a Currency

derivation: 1 has no decimal point, so it is an Integer (int64), as 100000 is in the article.
